name: rail-live-band-count-hover
description: rail Live band header: the count Badge stays visible (opacity 1, visibility visible, non-zero width inside the row's right edge) while the header row is hovered on a hover-capable desktop layout - a band has no actions to swap into the right slot, so the hover-hide rule for .rightSlot occupants must not reach it

mutation.declaration: harness: the Badge wrapper's class bandCount swapped for rightSlot, i.e. the count back in the shared slot the hover-hide rule targets
mutation.note: With the Badge inside .rightSlot, .railRow:hover .rightSlot > :not(.actions) sets opacity 0 and visibility hidden on it under (hover: hover) and (min-width: 900px), failing the opacity and visibility assertions. Restoring bandCount returns the case to PASS.
